final: WITH s AS (SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS a FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), b AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS base FROM s), q AS (SELECT AVG(s.a) AS qm FROM s, b WHERE s.a > b.base) SELECT s.brokrepstat, s.a AS avg_modelconf, s.a - b.base AS diff_from_baseline, s.a / q.qm AS ratio_to_qualifying_mean FROM s, b, q WHERE s.a > b.base AND b.base IS NOT NULL AND q.qm IS NOT NULL
